issues.description: The reference solution declares the Lecture constructor with package-private visibility (no access modifier) while the exercise text asks students to "Create a constructor" without specifying visibility. Students (or automated tests in other packages) will typically expect a public constructor; the solution's default visibility may therefore be unexpected and can cause instantiation failures from other packages or test code located outside the package.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the constructor explicitly public to match typical expectations and avoid package-access issues. Change the constructor declaration in Lecture.java to: public Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors) { ... } and update the template (and solution) accordingly, or explicitly state in the problem that a package-private constructor is intended.
